# Codex Quota & Rate Limit Reset Tracker
> Real-time utility tool for calculating OpenAI Codex token limits, 5-hour rolling windows, and local timezone reset schedules.

## Main Endpoints
- Index & Live Tracker: https://willcodexreset.com/
- 5-Hour Rolling Limit: https://willcodexreset.com/5-hour-limit/
- Rate Limit Comparison: https://willcodexreset.com/vs-claude-code/

## Supported Languages
- English (Default): https://willcodexreset.com/
- Japanese (日本語): https://willcodexreset.com/ja/
- Korean (한국어): https://willcodexreset.com/ko/
- German (Deutsch): https://willcodexreset.com/de/
- Spanish (Español): https://willcodexreset.com/es/
